title: Use RFC 5280 validity time encoding
description: Review finding from project-LICHEN-worker6-viku.1: spec/06-security.md:1250 mandates GeneralizedTime for all certificates, contradicting RFC 5280 which requires UTCTime through 2049 and GeneralizedTime from 2050. Update the profile and any independent conformance wording.
close_reason: Fixed §8.13.3 validity encoding: was 'MUST use GeneralizedTime' for all dates (non-compliant, would reject real CA-issued certs); now per RFC 5280 §4.1.2.5 — UTCTime for dates through 2049, GeneralizedTime for 2050+, both UTC/Zulu, per-date independent encoding. All 3 review passes delegated to kimi-k3 (correctness/security/edge-cases): PASS, PASS, PASS. Reviewers verified the 2049/2050 boundary, mixed-encoding reachability under the 397-day cap, UTCTime YY-window safety, and repo-wide absence of conflicting wording. No findings filed.
